knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "Jora Credit offers a simple, reliable way for underserved or underbanked Americans to get an installment loan when they need it most. As one of the best alternatives to payday lenders, our customers have the flexibility to repay the loan over a duration of time that makes sense for their lives and budget. With a simple and secure application process from any device, first-time customers can have $500 - $2,600 cash in their pocket as soon as the same business day."
